# Portrait example

Pete Souza / White House, official portrait of Barack Obama, 6 December 2012. U.S. federal government work, public domain.

Attribution / original: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Barack_Obama.jpg

This resized JPEG was obtained from Google's MediaPipe test fixture at https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/portrait.jpg . It is used as an editor/inference example. The original photograph is unchanged in portrait-demo.jpg. Retouch results and the deliberately faded/scratched sample are clearly user-generated or simulated modifications, not historical originals. No endorsement is implied.
